svg.title: How DoomLab turns a decision into a measured game action
svg.desc: All players share the same observations, action checks, execution, recordings and scoring. A single agent chooses an action directly. A multi-agent coordinator chooses a combat or navigation specialist. Invalid actions return an explanation to the same player. The game advances only when the executor presses buttons.

div.style: color: rgb(41, 40, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
